response.rationale: The English cue and sense are accurate. “Hidangan pembuka” is a valid Indonesian equivalent, and “pembuka selera” is the established Malaysian Malay equivalent for appetizer. The two localized forms support the different-common-word relation. No false-friend contrast is needed.
